Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 4  
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer incorrectly identified Don Hahn's birth year as 1932, which was actually Fernando Di Leo's birth year. This mistake led the Planner to conclude that Don Hahn was born earlier, when in reality, Fernando Di Leo was born in 1932 and Don Hahn in 1955. The error occurred in step 4 when the Planner used incorrect birth years for comparison.
